BRACKEN VALE INSTRUMENTS — SUPPLIER PROFILE
Record: Supplier file BV-417
Issued: 14 March 2025

Bracken Vale Instruments Ltd. supplies calibrated temperature probes and stainless mounting clips to North Quay Laboratory Services. The supplier account code is BV-417. The registered office is 18 Alder Quay, Bristol BS1 4NT, United Kingdom.

The account manager is Leona Price. Routine order questions go to orders@brackenvale.example. The supplier's standard dispatch window is two working days after confirmed payment. This profile does not state a warranty duration.

BV-417 — ACCOUNT APPENDIX

Approved items on this account are probe model BV-T9 and clip set BV-C2. The T9 probe range is -40 °C to 125 °C. The C2 clip set is supplied in cartons of 12.

Payment terms recorded for account BV-417: net 30 days from invoice date. Preferred currency: GBP. The account profile lists no bank account number and no named delivery driver.

Document control: supplier file BV-417, page 2 of 2. Prepared by M. Ellery, procurement coordinator.

NORTH QUAY LABORATORY SERVICES
QUALITY REVIEW QR-52
Review date: 8 April 2025

Subject: Incoming probe lot BV-L2403, supplied under order NQ-881. The inspection covered 24 BV-T9 probes. All 24 passed the temperature-response check at 0 °C and 80 °C.

The recorded reference bath was model AquaCal 6, asset AC-19. The review team was Priya Sen and Tomas Reed. This review does not record the probes' manufacturing country.

Finding: Two outer cartons had damp corners. Inner protective sleeves were dry, and no corrosion was observed.

QR-52 — REVIEW WORKSHEET CONTINUATION

The team recommends keeping the lot in ordinary dry storage. No special humidity threshold was entered. The inspection used procedure QP-14 revision 3.

Unresolved worksheet entries, both referring to the total number of probes in lot BV-L2403 inspected under NQ-881 on 8 April 2025:
• Field “sample count” on the signed table: 24 probes.
• Field “sample count” in the handwritten margin: 26 probes.

No correction, explanation, or later decision is attached to either entry. QR-52 pages 1 and 2 form one review packet.

Additional unresolved entries for this same 8 April inspection of BV-L2403:
• “Inspection date” in the cover summary: 8 April 2025.
• “Inspection date” in the worksheet header: 9 April 2025.
No note reconciles the two dates.

Bath asset reference for the same inspection:
• Signed equipment field: AC-19.
• Handwritten equipment field: AC-91.
Neither asset entry is marked corrected.

SERVICE TERMS ST-88
Bracken Vale Instruments Ltd. | issued 2 May 2025

For account BV-417, routine calibration service is offered at the Bristol workshop. Standard service turnaround is five working days after receipt of a probe. The service contact is calibration@brackenvale.example.

For BV-T9 probes, the included calibration interval stated in this terms sheet is 12 months. This sheet gives no field-repair price and no weekend opening hours.

ST-88 — SCHEDULE A

Workshop address: Unit 4, Redfern Estate, Bristol BS2 0LA. Customers must request a service reference before shipping instruments. The reference desk is open Monday to Friday, 09:00–16:00 local time.

The schedule does not specify the name of the workshop supervisor. Schedule A is part of service terms ST-88.

RIVERSIDE COMMONS ARBORETUM — PHENOLOGY FIELD LOG FL-88
Urban Ecology Unit | 6 May 2025

Study: spring flowering observations in the Lower Vale grove. Plot code LV-3. The field team surveyed the grove on 6 May 2025. Observer: Anika Bell.

This field log explicitly accompanies accession register AR-12: “Field log FL-88 accompanies accession register AR-12 for the Lower Vale grove observations recorded here.” The register identifies the tagged trees referenced in this log.

Field tally: 17 tagged trees were flowering during the morning survey. The count includes only trees with at least one open flower.

FL-88 — WEATHER AND CANOPY SHEET

Cloud cover at 08:00: overcast. Rain gauge total for the observation period: 3 mm. The grove is on the north bank of the River Wren, within Riverside Commons Arboretum.

Unresolved entries for the mean canopy temperature during the FL-88 survey of plot LV-3 on 6 May 2025:
• Digital logger summary: 14 °C.
• Field notebook transcription: 16 °C.
Neither value is annotated as corrected or preferred.

Unresolved entries for rainfall during that same observation period:
• Gauge worksheet: 3 mm.
• Observer's notebook: 5 mm.
No reconciliation is attached.

RIVERSIDE COMMONS ARBORETUM — ACCESSION REGISTER AR-12

Cross-reference: FL-88 states, “Field log FL-88 accompanies accession register AR-12 for the Lower Vale grove observations recorded here.” AR-12 applies to the tagged trees in that observation set.

Tag LV3-04 is assigned to the European beech, Fagus sylvatica. Accession number: RC-204. The tree stands at grid point C7 in plot LV-3.

Tag LV3-09 is assigned to the small-leaved lime, Tilia cordata. Accession number: RC-219. Grid point D2, plot LV-3.

AR-12 — REGISTER CONTINUATION

Tag LV3-12 is assigned to the English oak, Quercus robur. Accession number: RC-233. Grid point E5, plot LV-3.

For tagged tree LV3-04, the seed-capsule count recorded after the FL-88 observation is unresolved:
• Register table: 8 capsules.
• Margin note: 11 capsules.
Both entries refer to the same LV3-04 tree and the same 6 May 2025 observation; neither is marked corrected.

AR-12 is maintained by the Riverside Commons Arboretum Urban Ecology Unit. It does not state the planting year of LV3-04.
